 Through: Mr. Jai Prakash Narayan, Adv.
 versus
 Smt Shyam Kali And Ors ..
 Through:

 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Rekha Palli
 Order
% 18.01.2023
1.
Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

1. The present appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act preferred by the insurer seeks to assail the order dated 11.10.2022 passed by the learned MACT in so far as it relates to the quantum of compensation 2.
Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to the respondents through all permissible modes.
This is an application preferred by the appellant seeking stay of the impugned award.

5. The application is accordingly disposed of by directing the appellant to deposit within eight weeks, 70 % of the awarded amount with the learned Tribunal with a further direction to the Tribunal to release the same in favour of the respondents as per the disbursal scheme contained in the impugned award.
